product.title: Astroville Tunnel Tour of Downtown Houston (Air-Conditioned)

description.text: Walk Houston's climate-controlled downtown tunnels with a guide who covers skyscraper lobbies, Theater District connections, and underground city history. The outing finishes near Finn Hall after an orientation that stays cool even on hot Houston days. Stops include Downtown Houston Tunnels, Skyscraper Lobbies, Theater District, Finn Hall. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Houston skyline views, bayou corridors, and neighborhood landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Houston who want a guided Space City experience without coordinating meeting points or attraction entrances on their own.
